text:
Alice M.: Incident detected in eu-dedicated: DB connection pool exhaustion causing 502/503s. Putting today's 18:00 UTC release on hold. @oncall @eng-releases please standby.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 1823001122 — status: BLOCKED by incident: eu-db-spike. Canary paused.

Carla S.: We're throttling new connections and rolling partial restart on replica-2. ETA 15m.

Ben K.: Ack. For the release, recommend pinning API service to v2.1.3 in prod and delaying v2.2 canary. That's low-risk.

Dmitri P.: Agree. I'll push a quick hotfix toggle to disable the connection-hungry job: PR #412

Emily R.: I'll update the release notes + notify PMs and SRE. Draft note: "Release moved due to DB incident; new window TBD after stability."

Frank L.: We should also add a migration flag to the release notes to avoid automatic migrations during rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary for v2.2 rolled back to v2.1.3 on canary nodes. Logs: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=3```

Carla S.: Canary healthy on v2.1.3, error rate back to baseline. Holding full rollout until postmortem and config audit complete.

release-bot: Proposed new release window: 2026-04-06T14:00:00Z. Please vote :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to object.

Alice M.: +1 but only if SRE signs off on config audit. @dmitri please confirm.

Dmitri P.: Will confirm in 30m after running the audit script. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/eu-db-spike

incident-bot: Incident eu-db-spike severity=sev2, created=1823001000, status=investigating

Ben K.: OK. If audit passes, we'll re-run canary with migration flag off and monitor for 60m before ramp.

Emily R.: I'll set the release notes "On Hold - incident" tag and update the dashboard.

Alice M.: Thanks — I'll update the release channel and follow up in 1 hour. :eyes:
